risks.title: Recession and Economic Weakness
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly states that its success depends on economic and political conditions, and that recession, unemployment, and changes in interest rates could affect deposit levels, loan demand, and borrowers' repayment capacity.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates are explicitly identified as a risk that could affect deposit levels, loan demand, and net interest margins.

risks.title: Credit Risk and Loan Quality
risks.score_rationale: As a bank, the company is exposed to the risk that borrowers may fail to repay their loans, particularly during economic slowdowns affecting collateral values and repayment capacity.

risks.title: Real Estate Risk
risks.score_rationale: First Financial has significant exposure to real estate lending (residential and commercial). Changes in real estate values directly impact collateral quality and loan viability.

risks.title: Banking Regulation
risks.score_rationale: As an Ohio-chartered bank holding company, First Financial is subject to federal and state regulation. Changes in monetary policy and financial regulations could increase compliance costs.

risks.title: Geographic Concentration
risks.score_rationale: First Financial is a regional bank based in Cincinnati, Ohio. Its concentration in the Midwest and specific local markets creates exposure to regional economic downturns.

risks.title: Market Risk and Volatility
risks.score_rationale: First Financial is exposed to market risks through its wealth management services and securities portfolio, amid global economic volatility.
